sources.title: RolanDorisTech/Qwen3.8-9B-Distill-MLX-oQ5e · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-9B-Distill-oQ5e — 6.0GB MLX-native oQe MLX-native quantized version of Qwen3.8-9B-Distill, built with oMLX Universal Dynamic Quantization (oQe). Standard mlx-lm safetensors — works with mlx-lm, oMLX, LM Studio, and mlx-swift.

sources.title: AIAny - Qwen3.8-9B Distill
sources.snippet: A 9B-parameter distillation that transfers chain-of-thought reasoning from Qwen3.8 into the Qwen3.5-9B architecture for single‑GPU deployment; trained on ~70,000 teacher traces, it offers 262k-token context, native function-calling, and improved MMLU performance.
